label: Pharmacological modulation of TRPV2 enhances migration and induces Immunoglobulin E (IgE)-independent degranulation of mast cells.
summary: Transient receptor potential vanilloid 2 (TRPV2) is highly expressed in immune cells, including mast cells, yet its functional role in mast cell physiology remains incompletely understood.
